title: SEGA RALLY CHAMPIONSHIP / 1995 SEGA TWIN STATION
variant: One station adapted from the original white/blue 1995 Sega Rally Championship twin sit-down, with orange/blue marquee and striped white seat shells; not Sega Rally 2 or deluxe motion hardware
preview_note: 48 x 56 px | original white/blue twin station / Start + View / photographed Sega Rally high scores

research.finding: 1995 Sega AM3 game on Model 2, up to four arcade players through linked cabinets. Recipe seat count is descriptive, not a new catalog/core configuration; no Sega Rally catalog entry existed when this art was made.
HTTP 403; access restriction respected, not used as evidence.

Cabinet and control photographs located. Files indexed as srallycb and flyer srallyc actually show Sega Rally 2; retained as excluded research, never mixed into the 1995 artwork. No authenticated original operator decal scan located in this bounded search.

cabinet.purpose: Photograph of the original white/blue twin with 1995 orange/blue marquee, Race Leader headers, striped white seat backs, black cushions/dashboard, white CRT edging, blue platform edges, separate pedals and four-speed shifter. Supplies measured title, Race Leader header, seat-back and authentic Sega Rally high-score monitor rectifications. No alternate game's screen used.
cabinet.rights: Sega printed artwork/trademarks and game imagery; photo author, restoration status and redistribution rights unknown. Archive hosting is not publisher authorization.

controls.purpose: Sega Rally dashboard photograph corroborates yellow Start, red View Change, black hollow steering rim with silver three-spoke center, right-hand four-speed gate and black fascia. Only the original instruction panel is extracted; modeled controls are separate, not a pasted photographic steering wheel. Exact region and cabinet compatibility remain unverified.
controls.rights: Underlying Sega artwork; photograph author, cabinet region/restoration status and redistribution rights unknown. Archive hosting is not publisher authorization.

excluded_sequel_cabinet.purpose: EXCLUDED RESEARCH ONLY: archive filename srallycb is misleading. Marquee reads SEGARALLY2 and the cabinet has red tubular seat guards/yellow straps; not used for geometry, colors or textures.
excluded_sequel_cabinet.rights: Sega artwork/trademarks; photo author and redistribution rights unknown. Research archival copy, not publisher authorization.

excluded_sequel_flyer.purpose: EXCLUDED RESEARCH ONLY: despite filename srallyc, this flyer says first version, Model 3 Step 2.0 and shows the Sega Rally 2 cabinet. Not evidence for the original game's hardware or cabinet and never used as an artwork texture. Duplicate mmefly2b copy was identical and was not retained twice.
excluded_sequel_flyer.rights: Copyright Sega; third-party flyer scan provenance and redistribution permission unverified. Archive hosting is not publisher authorization.

uncertainties: Adapted one station of the photographed twin; the shared marquee is reduced over one CRT tower. Not claimed as a factory single-seat cabinet. Recipe players describes the original game's four-seat link capability, control_stations is one; no catalog/core/network configuration is added by this art task.

No authenticated original decal masters were located. Title, header and seat-back graphics are photo rectifications, not clean original scans. Original decoded downloads and hashes are retained without resizing; copyrights and photo redistribution rights remain unresolved.

Tower sides remain plain off-white because their prints are not documented by the selected photograph; no invented side decals or sequel artwork. Only the photographed seat back receives graphics, not unseen seat sides. Rear service vents and bucket curvature are generic pixel-scale estimates.

The CRT displays the original game's photographed Championship Top 10 high-score table. This is not a fresh local gameplay capture. A real frame from the in-progress Sega Rally core can replace it later; no unrelated game imagery or synthesized gameplay is substituted.

Shell dimensions and controls are estimates. White seat wings/back are separated from black cushion and dashboard. Start/View are two modeled buttons; steering, shifter and both pedals are independent geometry. Control photograph's exact variant/region is unverified but its two-button layout agrees with the selected cabinet.

The long footprint is compressed to 60 percent around the existing bottom-center cell anchor, height unchanged, to fit all four 48x56 rotations. Leave room around it when placing. Map placement, ROM downloads/uploads, game integration, commits and deployment are not included.
